findings.one_line: The full-class headline interval is a bare infimum/supremum over the expressly noncomputational, abstract correspondence S_h, so it is not an evaluable observed-law map as required for a delivered identifying bound.

The stated target is Theta(p_0), but the executable I_out brackets only Theta_cert(p_0); make the two deliverables and their targets explicit and do not present the subclass certificate as the functional for the full-class target.

The certification theorem needs theorem-level comparison sentences for the directly relevant verification/certification literature already cited (notably exact rational bound certification and neural branch-and-bound), rather than only the broad Duarte/Basu contrast.
